entities.name: Mallinbook
entities.release: ASC mapped, iOS + macOS 1.0 PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION; TestFlight build 13 VALID on both platforms (2026-08-01)
entities.description: Document-based macOS (flagship authoring) + iOS (companion) directory-book app: maintains member/resident rosters and generates print-ready saddle-stitch booklet PDFs, a web view, and Word export from one source of truth. A .mallinbook package = SQLite (GRDB) + lossless photos + frozen editions, synced via iCloud Documents.
notes: Renamed 2026-08-01 from bookmaker-app: repo/target/module and the document extension (.bookmaker -> .mallinbook); ASC identity unchanged (app id 6785245339), so earlier scans missed the repo.
Local version 1.0 (14) is one build ahead of TestFlight (13) — committed, not yet uploaded.
~/bookmaker (Python FastAPI/WeasyPrint engine) stays as the read-only reference implementation and one-time lossless photo-extraction pipeline.
First proving case: Mallinckrodt Condominium resident directory; bundled sample is the synthetic Maplecrest Towers book (80 fictional households).

entities.name: PickledBalls
